financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 19,205,000 common shares at $4.50 per share, closed March 1, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On March 1, 2024, the Company closed the sale of an aggregate of 19,205,000 shares of its common stock, pursuant to an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and Cowen and Company, LLC at a public offering price of $4.50 per share
